brief: An island-town cottage lot: Capt Bradley 2nd House 2, a 19th-century Lake Erie house; see the photo for its massing, porch and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: the Lake Erie shore towns that stand in for Victory Bay's island streets (Vermilion, Sandusky, Put-in-Bay) were built 1840-1920, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: Capt. Bradley's second house (Vermilion, 1880s): a two-storey vinyl-sided house split into two flats, two front doors with two mailboxes under a shared porch, an exterior brick chimney, a shingled addition; a felled tree's logs on the lawn

why.note: Vermilion OH, the village of lake captains
a big old house divided into flats
